## Detailed Project Descriptions

### Lattice Lab
URL: https://www.latticelab.fun/
A multi-agent research operating system for materials science. Seven autonomous AI researchers coordinate an end-to-end scientific discovery loop — reading prior arXiv literature, forming hypotheses, proposing atomic candidates, simulating structures, reviewing findings, and archiving verified results. Built with Next.js, Web3, and Tailwind CSS.

### SolTrace (Sol Tracer AI)
URL: https://soltracer.vercel.app/
An open-source conversational AI blockchain scanner for Solana. Features real-time wallet tracking, interactive visual money flow diagrams, drainer risk security audits, DEX swap analytics, token bundle intelligence, and prompt-driven transaction path tracing.

### Allpad
URL: https://www.allpad.online/
A live Solana market flow board and depth tape reader ranking the top ten busiest boosted mints by 24h turnover, with sub-minute order depth and price updates. Delivers high-speed market signal with session readouts for volume spikes and climb velocities.

### Anizuki
URL: https://www.anizuki.sbs/
Real-time anime trivia and multiplayer quiz battle arena built on Next.js. Features live player lobbies, PIN-based game rooms, instant head-to-head challenges, category playlists (Series, Movies, Games), achievements, and a global leaderboard.

### DOT — Sovereign Cryptographic Vault (Open Source)
URL: https://github.com/collinstheegod376/DOT
Live Demo: https://dot-eight-gilt.vercel.app/
A zero-server, self-custodial cryptographic Solana vault. Generates and encrypts private keys strictly on the local device, protected with biometric passkey authentication via device Secure Enclave, air-gapped QR transaction signing, and native/SPL token asset management.

### Arachnos AI — Local Learning Extension (Open Source)
URL: https://github.com/collinstheegod376/Arachnos-AI
A local-first Chrome extension (Manifest V3) and private AI companion featuring 60 FPS procedural inverse-kinematic animated spiders that visually crawl pages, harvest knowledge with silk tractor beams, and answer queries via private local RAG with zero cloud dependencies.

### Wheelrush
URL: https://wheelrush.fun/
Spin-to-win web game with virtual cash prizes from $500K to $10 Billion, featuring realistic physics simulations, tiered prize algorithms, and a global leaderboard.

### Orvix — Solana Dev Radar
URL: https://www.orvixagent.fun/
A Solana developer monitoring radar aggregating official network incident reports and Agave client releases into a filterable feed with auto-refresh, bookmarks, and raw JSON export.
